full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph shows a young woman in a dark brimmed hat amid a close crowd of men and softly obscured passersby. The setting is compressed by a pale, overexposed opening across the upper left and a darker vertical wall or doorway behind the right side. Near the center, the woman's dark hat makes a broad rounded arc over her forehead and short curled hair. Her face is the clearest surface in the frame: pale cheeks, sharply shaped brows, dark lips, and eyes turned toward the right side of the image. A small bright earring catches light beneath the brim. She wears a dark tailored garment with a narrow white opening at the chest, and her shoulders angle slightly away while her head turns back through the crowd. At the lower left, one hand rests near a rounded dark object at the edge of the frame. A man's dark hat and partly cropped face press in from the far left. Behind her, several men in hats and suits become increasingly pale and indistinct in the glowing haze; their faces form a loose row across the upper middle. At the right, a man in a light fedora and dark coat is closer than the background group, his downcast face partly shaded under the brim. A large pale shoulder enters from the lower right corner and blocks part of his body. Bright backlight floods the upper left, making the rear figures recede into a veil, while the woman's face receives enough softer frontal light to stay sharply readable against her black clothes. Film grain and deep tonal blacks give the photograph an aged tactile surface without losing the contrast between crisp foreground and misty depth. The overall composition is crowded yet quietly focused, with one illuminated face held between dark hats, pale haze, and cropped moving bodies.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头照片呈现一名戴深色宽檐帽的年轻女子，周围是靠得很近的男子和被柔和雾气遮掩的行人。场景被左上大片曝光偏亮的开口与右后方较暗的竖向墙面或门洞压缩起来。画面中央附近，女子的深色帽子在额头和短卷发上方形成宽阔圆弧。她的脸是画面中最清晰的表面：浅色双颊、形状分明的眉、深色嘴唇，以及转向画面右侧的眼睛。帽檐下，一枚小小的亮色耳饰接住光。她穿深色合身衣服，胸前有一道狭窄白色开口；肩膀略微转开，头却从人群中回望。左下方，一只手靠近画边的圆形深色物件。最左缘挤入一名男子的深色帽子和被裁去一部分的面孔。在她身后，几个戴帽穿西装的男子在发亮雾气中越来越浅淡模糊，他们的脸在上部中央排成松散的一列。右侧，一名戴浅色软呢帽、穿深外套的男子比背景人群更近，低垂的脸被帽檐部分遮住。右下角伸入一块大面积浅色肩膀，挡住他身体的一部分。强烈逆光灌满左上方，使后排人物退入一层白雾；女子的脸则得到足够柔和的正面光，仍能在黑衣前清楚辨认。胶片颗粒与深黑明度赋予照片陈旧而可触的表面，同时保留清晰前景与朦胧深处的反差。整体构图拥挤却安静地聚焦，以一张受光面孔置于深帽、浅雾和画边裁切的人体之间。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white photograph works through a wide spread of luminous whites, soft middle grays, and dense near-black. Strong backlight burns out part of the rear field and dissolves distant forms into haze, while selected foreground edges remain clean and sharply readable. Dark curved masses frame smaller pale areas and establish an immediate focal point without decorative color. Closely cropped forms overlap from the sides, giving the frame a compressed, spontaneous street-camera feeling. Light catches a few small reflective accents, but large dark surfaces stay almost featureless and weighty. Grain and slight atmospheric softness give the tonal transitions a tactile, aged quality rather than a polished digital finish. Depth is carried by a change from crisp near contours to low-contrast silhouettes behind them. The overall effect is intimate and watchful, with visual tension arising from bright space pressing against layered dark shapes.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅黑白摄影在发亮的白色、柔和中灰和浓密近黑色之间展开宽广的明度跨度。强烈逆光使后方部分区域曝光偏亮，远处形体融入雾气，少数前景边缘则保持干净清晰。深色弧形团块框住较小的浅色区域，无需装饰色彩便建立直接的视觉焦点。两侧裁切得很近的形体互相遮叠，赋予画幅压缩而即兴的街头抓拍感。少数细小反光点接住光，但大片深色表面仍近乎无细节而有重量。颗粒与轻微的空气柔化让明度过渡带有可触、陈旧的品质，而非光洁的数字质感。空间深度由近处清楚的轮廓向后方低反差剪影的变化承担。整体效果亲近而警觉，视觉张力来自明亮空间与层层深色形状的相互挤压。
theme_en: A dark-hatted woman in a crowded black-and-white street scene
theme_zh: 黑白街头人群中一位戴深色帽子的女子
name: Kurt Hutton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
